en: The Bedford’s second and third passages plotted on a 1719 world map.

These maps reveal key points on the ship Bedford's second and third transatlantic voyages trafficking enslaved African people. The voyages took place between 1804 and 1807, and we have used a map from 1719 to visualise the routes.
This resource covers sensitive topics and should be approached with care. It includes quotes from material that contains dehumanising and distressing descriptions of enslavement.
The resource was created using the following collection of records. The National Archives: C 114/158; T 71/119; T 71/65; T 71/164; T 70/1583 and T 70/1584/74.
